================================================================================
Asm clobbers as a struct literal
================================================================================

pub fn syscall0(number: u64) u64 {
    return asm volatile ("syscall"
        : [ret] "={rax}" (-> u64),
        : [number] "{rax}" (number),
        : .{ .rcx = true, .r11 = true, .memory = true });
}

pub fn flush() void {
    asm volatile ("flushw" ::: .{ .memory = true });
}
